hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit"; then echo "[hook] Commit detected -- invoke /progress-log to update the daily log."; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "vol-project-ref/chapters/.*\.tex"; then CHFILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP "ch\d+-[\w-]+\.tex" | head -1); MDFILE=$(echo "$CHFILE" | sed "s/\.tex$/.md/"); echo "[hook] vol-project-ref chapter source modified ($CHFILE). Update the corresponding markdown file: guides/vol-project-ref/markdown/$MDFILE"; fi'
